$schema_note: Machine-readable mirror of team/SCORECARD.md, which itself condenses team/plans/master-plan.md §'Stage 2 v2'. Consumed by scripts/scorecard.mjs. Category weights below sum to the judge weights: product_pull 30, demo_magnetism 25, api_gravity 20, loop_depth 15, craft 10 (=100).
